item.title: Overview of 1 Samuel - Two Kings, Two Ways
item.description: Adapted from insights by Ray C. Stedman and other biblical reflections. A narrative of two kings, two ways of living, and one God who weighs the heart._ Opening Story # Aaron lived most of his life by instinct. If something felt right, he did it. If something felt difficult, he avoided it. He believed in God, but only in the background, like an emergency number he might call if life collapsed.
